The 1994 individual best times were: U17 Bobby Peacock, 2:48 (12th lap), U15 Nigel Whorlow, 3:26 (10th lap), U13 Jason Stevens, 3:26 (9th lap).

Yet another medal was earned in this meeting - the Under 17 'silver' - which went to Robert Peacock. The League result also gave reasonable success to the Belgrave young athletes as the team took 3rd place in their first year in this event.
